name: German Postcodes and Places
description: The line of the postcode and the place: with and without a comma, with D- and DE- before the code and the country after the place, on lines of their own, with a hyphen, brackets, an Ortsteil, and with the postcode or the place missing. Original cases written for this corpus from Deutsche Post's addressing guidance and DIN 5008's layout, described in our own words; the postcodes and their Länder are GeoNames' (CC BY 4.0).
